user_objective: Faster generation (tokens per second) per session

current_observational_baseline.source: historical aggregate observation; underlying private production records are excluded
current_observational_baseline.scope: last hour heterogeneous actual production requests; no controlled causal comparison

measurements: Synthetic normal-API C1/C4/C8 with final SSE token usage, long actual outputs, per-stream rates and fairness
Solo request-local speculative confidence0.3/0.5/0.7, balanced repeat order, exact quality checks and native timings where valid
rules: Never count SSE chunks as tokens
Do not compare heterogeneous real-traffic rates against controlled benchmark rates as a speedup
Preserve all prior failed/inconclusive benchmark results
No output-shortening, reasoning removal, control-vector change or altered sampler presented as decoder improvement
No service mutation or restart during live baseline or request-local sweep
Reject or mark contaminated trials if external activity or batch migration prevents valid solo timing
Current full eight-deep simultaneous generation remains unqualified; modest prompt concurrency is a different scope
promotion_gate: A repeatable matched gain, no checked quality regression, full capacity/vision/auth/readiness preserved; no unmeasured universal throughput promise

predeclared_candidate_screen.primary_comparison: matched native generation tokens/s within each frozen style; whole-request rates reported separately
predeclared_candidate_screen.a_screen_winner_is_not_a_production_prom: requires fresh matched confirmation and validation of any global startup change at concurrent load
predeclared_candidate_screen.no_winner_outcome: retain approved current settings and report that no repeatable gain was established
